test_cases.name: word_lock
test_cases.desc: Receiver locks word boundary on the Synchronization Word 0x78f678f678f6.

test_cases.name: lane_deskew
test_cases.desc: Bonded lanes are deskewed using successive metaframe boundaries.

test_cases.name: descrambler_sync
test_cases.desc: Scrambler State Word synchronizes the per-lane descrambler (x^58 + x^39 + 1).

test_cases.name: burst_framing
test_cases.desc: Burst Control Word (SOP) and Idle/Burst Control Word (EOP, EOP_Format) delimit a packet's bursts.

test_cases.name: crc24_error
test_cases.desc: Corrupted burst flagged by CRC-24 (poly 0x328B63) mismatch -> burst errored.

test_cases.name: crc32_lane_error
test_cases.desc: Diagnostic Word CRC-32 (poly 0x04C11DB7) detects a per-lane error.

test_cases.name: flow_control_xoff
test_cases.desc: XOFF in the calendar back-pressures a channel; XON resumes it.

test_cases.name: skip_clock_comp
test_cases.desc: Skip Words are added/deleted to absorb the clock-rate difference.

test_cases_present: partial - the spec provides functional descriptions and waveform figures that map to compliance test scenarios but does not provide a formal test plan or testbench.
